messages:
maya: quick poll: if you could only keep one condiment in the office fridge forever, what would it be? and why?
ron: Sriracha. versatile, eternal. :hot_pepper:
leo: Ranch. controversial but heals all salads.
anya: Lemon juice. brightens things and doubles as cleaning hack.
maya: Ooh @anya practical. ever used condiments for non-food stuff?
ron: once used mayo to fix a stuck ring (dont try at home). worked tho.
leo: mustard as stain pretreatment? heard it works on grease.
anya: I use ketchup packets as tiny ice packs in lunches sometimes.
maya: Favorite underrated condiment is olive tapenade in my book. weirdly elevates toast.
leo: vote tally so far: Sriracha 1, Ranch 1, Lemon juice 1. tie breaker needed.
snack-bot: FYI: Office kitchen restock tomorrow at 10am. bring requests to #random.
anya: If we're doing utility, i'm switching my vote to lemon juice. multiuse win.
ron: concession: lemon juice is solid. i'll accept sriracha on the side.
maya: Decision: lemon juice reigns. thanks all. small prize: bring your condiment of choice to show-and-taste next Wednesday?
leo: i'll bring tiny ranch cups.
ron: i'll bring sriracha minis.
anya: lemon wedges arranged artfully.
maya: this thread made me hungry and oddly domestic. thanks team. :sparkles:
